findings.statement: CA9 is the top convergence gene: tumour-up in RNA (log2FC [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=6.31]) and protein (log2FC [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.27]), replicates in TCGA-KIRC and persists after purity extrapolation, with girentuximab in clinical development. Caveat: GTEx vital-organ proteome shows stomach enrichment (TS [gene=CA9; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=5.19]), an on-target off-tumour flag, and it is not prognostic in TCGA.

CD70 is a membrane ligand up in tumour at protein (log2FC [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.42]) and RNA (log2FC [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=4.46]), replicated in TCGA-KIRC, with antibody-based agents in clinical trials. Vital-organ tissue specificity is low (TS [gene=CD70; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=0.34]), a favourable safety profile.

ENPP3 is a surface enzyme with tumour-up protein (log2FC [gene=ENPP3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.54]), replication in TCGA-KIRC and an ADC (AGS-16C3F) already tested. No vital-organ enrichment (TS [gene=ENPP3; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=0.0]).

NNMT is up at protein (log2FC [gene=NNMT; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.71]) and RNA (log2FC [gene=NNMT; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=4.67]), replicates in TCGA, is tumour-intrinsic after purity correction, and high expression predicts worse survival. It ranks near the top of the biomarker profile. No approved drug.

SCARB1 (HDL receptor, lipid uptake) is first in the target profile: protein is up (log2FC [gene=SCARB1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.84]), it replicates in TCGA-KIRC and is tumour-intrinsic, with Open Targets genetic support. It is not prognostic and has no ccRCC-selective dependency.

SLC16A3 (MCT4, lactate export) has coherent three-layer up-regulation with protein log2FC [gene=SLC16A3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.28], TCGA replication and a positive copy-number cis effect; it fits the glycolytic, HIF-driven phenotype. Survival association is borderline.

HILPDA, a hypoxia-inducible lipid-droplet regulator, is strongly up in RNA (log2FC [gene=HILPDA; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=5.12]) with protein confirmation and a positive CNV cis effect; it reflects HIF activation after VHL loss, more as a pathway marker than a drug target (no tractability, no prognosis).

UMOD is one of the most strongly down genes (RNA log2FC [gene=UMOD; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-10.31]) with protein loss and TCGA replication, a marker of lost thick ascending limb identity; a diagnostic tissue biomarker, not a target.

ALDOB (proximal tubule) is lost in tumour (RNA log2FC [gene=ALDOB; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-7.03]), replicates in TCGA, survives purity extrapolation, and low expression is associated with worse survival: a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker.

PSAT1 tops the biomarker profile: protein is down in tumour (log2FC [gene=PSAT1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-1.96]), replicated in TCGA, and its expression associates with worse survival there and with grade.

VHL is the disease driver: 3p loss in [gene=VHL; type=omics_cnv; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-CNV; arm=3p; loss_freq=79.1%] of CPTAC tumours and recurrent somatic mutation in [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; freq=48.3%] of the combined cohort. It explains HIF-driven genes such as CA9, HILPDA and SLC16A3, but is not directly druggable.

caveats: Gene-level ranking relies on bulk tumour vs adjacent normal; tubule-identity genes (UMOD, ALDOB) reflect cell-of-origin loss.
GTEx proteome has no kidney and limited detection; absence of vital-organ signal is not proof of safety.
DepMap/PRISM 2D culture misses HIF-2 biology, so no target here shows ccRCC-selective dependency; evidence is expression-based.
Survival results are univariate TCGA Cox models without adjustment for stage.
Purity, drug_response, phosphosite and kinase layers were only reviewed through ranking components for most genes.
